hero.titleLine1: Discover the Beauty of Sri Lanka with
hero.description: We offer private tours, airport transfers and car rental with a professional driver. Explore breathtaking destinations, enjoy comfortable private transportation and discover Sri Lanka with a friendly, certified local driver-guide.

services.title: How We Can Help You
services.subtitle: Whether you need a punctual arrival greeting, a multi-day private tour or a personal driver at your disposal, each journey is executed with quiet discretion and refinement.

airport.title: Airport Transfers
airport.description: Direct greeting at Bandaranaike International Airport with a personalised name board. Flight delay tracking, ice-cold bottled water and plush leather air-conditioned seating.
features: Flight tracking with complimentary waiting time
Direct express highway tolls & parking included

round-tours.title: Private Round Tours
round-tours.description: Immersive, unhurried journeys through the Cultural Triangle, mist-capped tea estates, highland railways and wildlife sanctuaries, with a local driver-companion.
features: Bespoke daily itineraries tailored to your rhythm
Train ticket reservations & safari jeep sync

car-rental.title: Car Rental with Private Driver
car-rental.description: Enjoy complete freedom without the stress of navigating mountain roads. Hire an executive vehicle with a professional chauffeur for 5, 7 or 14+ days.
features: Unlimited flexibility to alter stops daily
English or Russian speaking chauffeur choice

day-tours.title: Day Tours
day-tours.description: Short on time? Enjoy a comfortable full-day trip to the best sights near you and be back at your hotel by evening.
features: Pick-up and drop-off at your hotel
Flexible stops for photos and meals
Popular routes or your own choice

city-tours.title: City Tours
city-tours.description: Explore the history, markets and landmarks of Colombo, Kandy or Galle with a friendly local who knows the best places.
features: Temples, forts, museums and local markets
Local tips on food and shopping

custom-itineraries.title: Customized Itineraries
custom-itineraries.description: Tell us your dates, interests and budget, and we will design a travel plan made just for you.
features: Easy changes before and during the trip

packages.title: Popular Journeys Across Sri Lanka
packages.subtitle: Handpicked tours for first-time visitors and returning travelers. Every tour can be customized to your dates, interests and group size.
packages.footerNote: Don’t see your ideal trip? Contact us and we will design a custom plan for you.

sigiriya-dambulla.title: Sigiriya & Dambulla
sigiriya-dambulla.description: Climb the ancient Lion Rock fortress and explore the golden cave temple in comfort.

kandy.title: Kandy Cultural Tour
kandy.description: Visit the hill capital, its sacred temple and peaceful gardens, and enjoy a traditional dance show.

ella-nuwara-eliya.title: Ella & Nuwara Eliya Hill Country
ella-nuwara-eliya.description: Cool mountain air, endless tea plantations, waterfalls and the famous scenic train ride.

galle-south-coast.title: Galle Fort & Southern Coast
galle-south-coast.description: Walk the old Dutch fort, relax on golden beaches and enjoy the best of the southern coast.

yala-safari.title: Yala Safari Adventure
yala-safari.description: Spot leopards, elephants and many birds on a jeep safari in Sri Lanka’s best-known national park.

classic-sri-lanka.title: Classic Sri Lanka
classic-sri-lanka.description: The best of the island in one trip: ancient cities, tea country, wildlife and the southern beaches.

about.title: Meet Your Dedicated Driver-Guide
about.paragraph: We are a family-owned Sri Lankan tour operator based in Weligama, Sri Lanka, specializing in personalized private tours and transfers. My name is Dhananjaya (Dhana) and I am a licensed driver with over 10 years of experience helping travelers from around the world explore the island safely and comfortably.

driver.title: Experienced & Licensed Driver
driver.text: Years of professional experience driving across Sri Lanka, fully certified for tourism.

itineraries.title: Customized Itineraries
itineraries.text: Every trip is tailored to your pace, preferences and budget. No rush, no stress.

vehicles.title: Safe & Insured Vehicles
vehicles.text: Air-conditioned, modern cars and vans regularly inspected for your safety and comfort.

support.title: 24/7 WhatsApp Support
support.text: We stay in touch before and throughout your journey to answer questions and help.

gems.title: Local Hidden Gems
gems.text: Beyond the tourist spots - discover local food, quiet beaches and authentic culture.

direct.title: Direct Driver Booking
direct.text: Deal directly with us, not a middleman agency. Clear communication and fair prices.

reviews.title: What Our Guests Say
reviews.emptyText: Guest reviews will appear here soon. Traveled with us? We would love to hear about your trip.

contact.title: Plan Your Trip With Us
contact.subtitle: Questions about a tour, a transfer or a custom plan? Message us any time and we will get back to you.
